content:
q28.

**`s3presign.Runner`** — `time.Ticker` at a **12-hour interval** (`runnerInterval`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`). Started in `server.Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:153-171`): an initial `RunOnce` call executes immediately at startup, then a goroutine runs the ticker loop via `s3presignRunner.Run(ctx)`. It re-presigns S3 attachment URLs before they expire.

That is the **only** runner the server actually starts. One runner per line:

- **s3presign.Runner** — 12-hour `time.Ticker` (plus one immediate run at startup)

**Unused infrastructure:** The `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14`) is fully implemented (rebuilds memo payloads by re-parsing markdown) and lives in the `server/runner/` directory alongside `s3presign`, but it is **never instantiated or called** by the server. `memopayload.NewRunner` and `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` have zero callers (certified zero from the code graph). It has no scheduling loop (`Run` method) at all — only a one-shot `RunOnce` — and `startBackgroundRunners` does not reference it.
